_about: Tool map for ReconQA's built-in API driver (drivers/api/server.mjs), used by the write gate. Any tool on this server that is not listed is denied. The driver itself keeps requests on app.api.base_url, allows writes only with allow_create on a test server, and changes or deletes only records the run created.

ask_reasons.api_delete: deletes a record on the API server (only records this run created)
